topics.title: Write a Paragraph about How to Stay Connected with Family and Friends While Travelling
guiding_questions: How do you stay connected while travelling?
What apps or tools do you use?
When do you contact your family and friends?
How does it make you feel?
topics.sample_essay: When I travel, I stay connected with my family and friends. I use my phone to call them every day. I use WhatsApp to send messages and photos. Sometimes we make video calls. I also send emails. I contact them in the evening. Staying connected is very important. It makes me feel close to home.

topics.title: Write a Paragraph about an Event or a Celebration You Have Been To or Read About
guiding_questions: What was the event or celebration?
When and where did it happen?
How did you feel about it?
topics.sample_essay: Last year, I went to my cousin's wedding. It was in a big hotel. My family was there. The bride wore a white dress. We ate good food and danced a lot. I met my cousins and we laughed together. The music was beautiful. I felt so happy that day. It was a lovely celebration.
